# opnsense_plugin_status (Data Source)

Reads cached local OPNsense package/plugin state through api-extensions without refreshing remote firmware repositories or mutating the appliance.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Exact OPNsense package/plugin name.

### Read-Only

- `installed` (Boolean) Whether the package is currently installed.
- `locked` (Boolean) Whether the package is locked against firmware changes.
- `origin` (String) Package origin recorded by the local package database.
- `provided` (Boolean) Whether the package is available in cached local package metadata.
- `repository` (String) Repository recorded by the local package database.
- `version` (String) Installed/provided package version reported by the local package database.
